citation: Petra Demény, Borbála Tegze, Bálint Fodor, Pál Maák, János Madarász, Zsombor Pap, Dániel Zámbó, Tamás Igricz, Adél Sarolta Rácz, Norbert Nagy, Zoltán Hórvölgyi. Titania-Supported Photocatalytic Coatings of Cu2O Nanoparticles Synthesized via Heterogeneous Nucleation. ACS Omega 2026, 11, 5374-5383. https://doi.org/10.1021/acsomega.5c08505
material_description: Three individually-characterized coating layers relevant to the TiO2/Cu2O photocatalytic stack: the mesoporous TiO2 active layer, the compact silica barrier layer deposited beneath it, and a mesoporous silica reference coating grown separately for comparison. Material identity for each measurement is given per-row in the 'Sample' column.
measurement_purpose: Characterize the optical and physical properties (effective refractive index, layer thickness, porosity) of each individual coating layer via spectroscopic ellipsometry, to support optical modeling of the multilayer TiO2/silica coating stack. The 'mesoporous silica' row is itself an internal reference/comparison sample within this table, included to show how the mesoporous TiO2 layer's properties differ from an otherwise-similar mesoporous silica coating.
table_title: Table S1: Effective refractive index, layer thickness and porosity values of the mesoporous TiO2 coatings, the compact silica barrier layers and the mesoporous silica reference coatings.
